#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

struct Node {
    int diff;
    int indx;
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;

    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    std::vector<int> oddEven(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
        if (i == 0) {
            oddEven[i] = (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
        } else {
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] + ((arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1);
        }
    }

    int m = n - 1;
    std::vector<Node> diffArr(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        diffArr[i].diff = std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
        diffArr[i].indx = i;
    }

    std::sort(diffArr.begin(), diffArr.end(),
              [](const Node& a, const Node& b) {
                  if (a.diff != b.diff)
                      return a.diff < b.diff;
                  return a.indx < b.indx;
              });

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        if (k >= diffArr[i].diff && oddEven[diffArr[i].indx] == 0) {
            if (k - diffArr[i].diff >= 0) {
                ++ans;
                k -= diffArr[i].diff;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
